

// package main


use std::ops::ControlFlow;


fn main( ) -> (()) {
    
        

let mut numbers = vec![1, 2].into_iter();





while let Some(number) = numbers.next() {
    

print!("number {}", number);



}










let mut pairs = vec![(3, 4)].into_iter();





while let Some((left, right)) = pairs.next() {
    

print!("pair {} {}", left, right);



}










struct Pair { name: String, coordinates: (i32, i32) }





while let Some(Pair { name, coordinates: (x, y) }) = Some(Pair { name: String::from("record"), coordinates: (5, 6) }) {
    

print!("record {} {} {}", name, x, y);




break;



}










let borrowed = Some(String::from("retained"));





while let Some(text) = &borrowed {
    

print!("borrowed {}", text);




break;



}











while let Some(ref text) = borrowed {
    

print!("explicit modifier {}", text);




break;



}










print!("owner {}", borrowed.as_ref().unwrap());





while let ControlFlow::Continue((first, second)) = ControlFlow::<(), (i32, i32)>::Continue((7, 8)) {
    

print!("import {} {}", first, second);




break;



}









    
}
